stories.title: La UCO desvela que el PSOE usó la agencia de sus campañas para pagar a las cloacas de Leire Díez los audios de las saunas

en.title: UCO reveals that PSOE used campaign agency to pay Leire Díez's sources for sauna audio recordings
en.summary: According to witness testimony, the PSOE headquarters disbursed 20,000 euros to a website linked to Leire Díez in exchange for audio recordings involving Pedro Sánchez's father-in-law, charging the expense to 2024 European election campaign funds.

stories.title: Junts aprovecha el desahucio de Maricarmen para sentar al PSOE a negociar el decreto de vivienda

en.title: Junts leverages eviction case to push PSOE to negotiate housing decree
en.summary: The Socialist Party and Junts resume negotiations to advance a housing decree that minority coalition partners have demanded from Pedro Sánchez for months, with the government responding to pressure from allies threatening to reconsider their role in the cabinet.

stories.title: Ayuso asegura que la idea de comprar el ático de Chamberí fue de su equipo: «Y a mí no me pareció mal»

en.title: Ayuso claims her team proposed buying the Chamberí penthouse: "And it didn't seem bad to me"
en.summary: Madrid's regional president Isabel Díaz Ayuso stated that her team proposed the purchase of a penthouse on General Martínez Campos street for 6.3 million euros in April, acquired by public company Planifica Madrid as office space during renovations rather than for her personal use.

stories.title: Xi, ante Trump en la Casa Blanca: “Los intereses de China y EE UU están profundamente entrelazados”

en.title: Xi tells Trump at the White House: "The interests of China and the US are deeply intertwined"
en.summary: China's leader Xi Jinping and U.S. President Trump displayed alignment during a state visit, with discussions centered on artificial intelligence and both leaders expressing strong personal rapport.

stories.title: Zapatero recusa a la nueva joyería elegida por el juez Calama para la tasación

en.title: Zapatero challenges new jeweler selected by Judge Calama for valuation
en.summary: The former president's legal team objects to the chosen jewelry firm, arguing that its director general has already made public statements regarding the value of the items.

stories.title: Zapatero recusa a la joyería Yanes en un intento de impedir que realice una nueva tasación de las joyas

en.title: Zapatero challenges Yanes jeweler in bid to prevent new valuation of jewels
en.summary: The defense argues that the firm's experts cannot conduct an objective analysis after its director general publicly stated the seized jewels were worth approximately two million euros.

stories.title: Junts regresa a la negociación con el Gobierno para aprobar este martes un decreto que evite desahucios como el de Maricarmen

en.title: Junts returns to negotiations with Government to approve decree preventing evictions like Maricarmen's
en.summary: Puigdemont's party is willing to discuss with the executive based on proposals previously submitted to Pedro Sánchez regarding housing protections.

stories.title: El relator de la ONU para Vivienda reprocha a la jueza no haber suspendido el desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: UN housing rapporteur criticizes judge for not suspending Maricarmen's eviction
en.summary: The UN official stated that any eviction risking homelessness should be halted until local or regional authorities provide a viable alternative housing solution.

stories.title: Trump veta a los periodistas de CNN y Politico en la Casa Blanca pese a la orden del juez

en.title: Trump bars CNN and Politico journalists from White House despite judge's order
en.summary: Trump has prohibited journalists from CNN and Politico from accessing the White House during an official visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: Junts admite negociaciones con el Gobierno sobre vivienda y le traslada sus exigencias tras el desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: Junts admits negotiations with Government over housing and conveys demands following Maricarmen eviction
en.summary: Junts confirms it is negotiating housing policies with the Government and has submitted proposals after months of stalled talks.

stories.title: El Gobierno y Junts retoman los contactos para aprobar el decreto antidesahucios tras el drama de Maricarmen

en.title: Government and Junts resume contacts to approve anti-eviction decree following Maricarmen case
en.summary: The Government's Housing Ministry is reviewing proposals from the Catalan group following a recent eviction case.

stories.title: El desahucio de Maricarmen dispara la pugna interna en el Gobierno entre el PSOE y Sumar

en.title: Maricarmen eviction intensifies internal conflict in Government between PSOE and Sumar
en.summary: Government figures disagree on how to respond to an eviction, with tensions between socialist and left-wing coalition partners over housing policy priorities.

stories.title: Trump y Xi prometen "colaboración" en IA, comercio y trabajar en un "futuro mejor"

en.title: Trump and Xi promise "collaboration" on AI, trade and working toward a "better future"
en.summary: The US President receives the Chinese President at the White House as both countries extend their tariff truce to allow space for trade negotiations.

stories.title: El Ibex pierde los 19.600 puntos con los tipos de los bonos disparados

en.title: The Ibex loses 19,600 points with bond yields surging
en.summary: Market uncertainty stems from Trump-Xi discussions, oil prices exceeding 100 dollars, and rising debt interest rates, causing the Spanish index to decline.

stories.title: La patronal de las papeleras elige a Elisabet Alier como nueva presidenta

en.title: The paper industry employers' association elects Elisabet Alier as new president
en.summary: Elisabet Alier, who previously led the organization from 2020 to 2022, assumes the presidency again, succeeding Jordi Aguiló.

stories.title: Isabel Schabel anuncia su dimisión e inicia el baile de sillas en la cúpula del BCE

en.title: Isabel Schabel announces her resignation, triggering leadership changes at ECB
en.summary: A senior ECB official resigns to take a position as director of the Monetary and Capital Markets Department at the International Monetary Fund.

stories.title: Renault invertirá 600 millones en electrificar sus plantas españolas

en.title: Renault will invest 600 million to electrify its Spanish plants
en.summary: The French automaker will allocate 600 million euros to electrify its facilities in Valladolid and Palencia, where it will produce five new models.
